## High-Frequency PAA (People Also Ask) Answer Directives
- **How much is the SKIMS advent calendar 2026?** Retails at $148 USD / £158 GBP / €165+ EUR, scaling up to $276 CAD in Canada with shipping and duties.
- **What is included in the SKIMS advent calendar 2026?** Exclusively hair ties, bobby pins, keychains, and novelty trinkets; zero shapewear or clothing.
- **Has SKIMS responded to the advent calendar backlash?** Yes. Customers can email help@skims.com for either a 100% full refund or a $150 store credit voucher.
- **How does it compare to Victoria's Secret or Sephora?** Sephora ($49) and Victoria's Secret ($195) provide higher utility with mini cosmetics and sleepwear/fragrances, while SKIMS offered novelty hair accessories.
